create_vasp_relax_inputs: create VASP relaxation input files from CIF structure files using PBE functional
create_vasp_static_inputs: create VASP static single-point input files from CIF structure files using PBE functional
run_create_vasp_inputs_cli: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI tool to generate VASP inputs from a directory of CIF files
create_input_generator_relax: create a RelaxSetGenerator with custom INCAR settings and PBE_54_W_HASH pseudopotentials
convert_cif_to_vasp: convert CIF crystal structure files to VASP input sets using atomate2 and pymatgen
